card.name: Linking words in DRESS syndrome descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas just before a list of symptoms or drug names, mainly in DRESS (drug rash with eosinophilia) warnings. Also fires on the start of GM-CSF (GM, granulocyte).
